title: Formulary Benefit: Whole-Cycle Alignment of Home-Delivery Transition Supplies with Other Transition Supplies
content:
**Alignment clause.** Under the Formulary Benefit, the starting length of a home-delivery transition supply is set in whole dose cycles against the member's other transition supplies. One dose cycle of the drug is the days supply of the member's latest shipped home delivery order of it, divided by that order's quantity. The member's transition-fill history is read for supplies of other drugs that are dated inside the current transition window, meaning a fill date on or after the transition start date.

- **(a) Retail supply running.** The member's latest retail transition supply of another drug is dated inside the window and still running on the handling date. The starting length is the days from the handling date through that supply's last day (its days supply less the days from its fill date to the handling date), rounded down to whole dose cycles. That is the days divided by the dose-cycle length, rounded down to a whole number, and multiplied by that length.
- **(b) Specialty supply running.** No such retail supply is running, but the latest specialty transition supply of another drug is dated inside the window and still running. The starting length is the days through that specialty supply's last day, rounded down to whole dose cycles in the same way.
- **(c) Otherwise.** The starting length is the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill, which is **30** days on every Northbridge formulary.

The supply is then worked from this starting length. It is held between zero and the formulary's maximum only at the end, and taken in whole days.

## Worked cases (hypothetical; latest shipped home delivery order 28 days, quantity 4, so one dose cycle is 7 days)

| Running transition supply of another drug on the handling date | Days to its last day | Starting length |
|---|---|---|
| retail, inside the window | 20 | 14 (two whole cycles) |
| no retail; specialty, inside the window | 27 | 21 (three whole cycles) |
| retail dated before the transition start date; no specialty | | 30 |
| retail inside the window, 5 days left | 5 | 0 (no whole cycle) |
